records.name: Diva Eigenbild
records.biography_en: Checks whether the moment is worth having once it has been seen. Her HyperNorm mirror certifies the moment before she agrees to inhabit it. A dissonant card asks whether the unphotographed part might also belong to her. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Augenblick wird nach Prüfung seiner Ansicht freigegeben.

variant_notes.note_en: Checks whether the moment is worth having once it has been seen.

records.name: Herr Großgenug
records.biography_en: Feels larger whenever somebody else agrees to keep holding the string. His gold HyperNorm balloon grows convincing whenever somebody holds the string. A dissonant card asks whether being supported has to mean being enlarged. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Größe hängt weiterhin an einer kleinen Zustimmung.

variant_notes.note_en: Feels larger whenever somebody else agrees to keep holding the string.

records.name: Klatscherin Mehrdavon
records.biography_en: Has saved enough approval to worry constantly about running out. Her HyperNorm box stores proof that she was worth noticing. A dissonant card sits beside her without adding a token or asking her to perform. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Anerkennung ist gesichert und bereits wieder knapp.

variant_notes.note_en: Has saved enough approval to worry constantly about running out.

records.name: Pokalkurator Hochglanz
records.biography_en: Maintains the proof so carefully that the achievement rarely gets a turn. His HyperNorm cups shine more clearly than the achievements they preserve. A dissonant card asks what he enjoyed before there was anything to display. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Nachweis wurde durch wiederholte Pflege aufgewertet.

variant_notes.note_en: Maintains the proof so carefully that the achievement rarely gets a turn.

records.name: Megafonist Ichzuerst
records.biography_en: Includes everyone by making sure they can all hear about him. His HyperNorm megaphone makes participation available at a safely one-sided volume. A dissonant card asks whether listening might also include him. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die allgemeine Teilnahme besteht aus gleichmäßiger Beschallung.

variant_notes.note_en: Includes everyone by making sure they can all hear about him.

records.name: Komplimentangler Beifang
records.biography_en: Asks an innocent question and waits for the reassuring part to bite. His HyperNorm mirror lure asks a question with a preferred answer attached. A dissonant card offers an honest kindness that refuses to bite the hook. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Frage ist beiläufig. Die erwünschte Antwort wartet schon.

variant_notes.note_en: Asks an innocent question and waits for the reassuring part to bite.
